description: Golden fixtures for Multiple Attack Penalty (MAP) calculation (PF2e Remaster).

cases.description: Non-agile weapon: first attack has no penalty
Non-agile weapon: second attack penalty is -5
Non-agile weapon: third (and beyond) attack penalty is -10
Non-agile weapon: fourth attack still applies the same -10 cap
cases.rule: §1.4: 3º+ ataque com arma padrão → penalidade −10 (não piora além de -10)

cases.description: Agile weapon: first attack has no penalty
cases.rule: §1.4 + §6.3 Agile: 1º ataque — penalidade 0 independente do trait

cases.description: Agile weapon: second attack penalty is -4
cases.rule: §1.4 + §6.3 Agile: 2º ataque com arma agile → penalidade −4 (em vez de −5)

cases.description: Agile weapon: third (and beyond) attack penalty is -8
cases.rule: §1.4 + §6.3 Agile: 3º+ ataque com arma agile → penalidade −8 (em vez de −10)

cases.description: Agile weapon: fourth attack still capped at -8
cases.rule: §1.4 + §6.3 Agile: 3º+ com agile → penalidade −8 (não piora além de -8)

cases.description: MAP applies to the attack roll only, not damage
cases.rule: §1.4: 'O MAP se aplica à jogada de ataque, não ao dano'

cases.description: MAP resets at start of each character turn
cases.rule: §1.4: 'É resetado no início de cada turno do personagem'; first attack in new turn = 0 penalty

cases.description: Mixed scenario: first strike with non-agile, second with agile — each uses own MAP value
cases.rule: §1.4: a penalidade do MAP é determinada pelo número de ataques feitos no turno (2nd attack = MAP step 2); arma agile aplica -4
cases.verifyNote: PF2e RAW: MAP step is based on total attacks made this turn, regardless of weapon order. Agile penalty applies to the weapon making the current attack. Confirm implementation tracks total attack count vs. per-weapon count.

cases.description: MAP is based on attacks with the Attack trait — other actions do not increment MAP
cases.rule: §1.3 trait Attack: 'Gera MAP; conta para o limite de MAP da rodada'; ações sem trait Attack (como Stride) não incrementam MAP
